info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Subscription Management API
info.description: The Subscription Management API allows businesses to manage customer subscriptions efficiently. This endpoint specifically handles the cancellation of individual subscriptions, enabling organizations to maintain accurate subscription records. Typical consumers include customer service teams and billing departments that require the ability to manage subscription lifecycles. By integrating this API, businesses can streamline their subscription processes and enhance customer satisfaction.

delete.summary: Remove a subscription for a specific customer.
delete.description: This endpoint allows you to delete a subscription associated with a particular customer. Ensure that you have the necessary permissions to perform this action as it will permanently remove the subscription from the system.

requestBody.description: Request body to delete a specific subscription for the given customer. This operation removes the subscription identified by the provided subscription ID from the customer's account.

204.description: Request completed successfully, the subscription has been deleted.

DeleteCustomerSubscriptionCUST100045RES1.description: This schema represents the request body for deleting a subscription associated with a specific customer.

DeleteCustomerSubscriptionCUST100045RES1.title: Delete Subscription Response
DeleteCustomerSubscriptionCUST100045RES1.description: This schema represents the response returned upon successfully deleting a subscription.

Metadata.title: Response Metadata

responseId.description: A unique identifier for the response.

correlationId.description: A unique identifier to track the request and response across systems.

generatedAt.description: The timestamp when the response was generated.

processingRegion.description: The geographic region where the processing took place.

Metadata.description: This schema contains metadata information related to the response.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: This header specifies the unique identifier for the endpoint used in the operation, providing the necessary context for understanding the request's source.

X-Runtime-App.description: This header indicates the name of the application processing the request, which can be useful for tracing and monitoring the application's performance.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses the Bearer authentication method, where a token is passed in the authorization header. The token format is expected to be a JSON Web Token (JWT).
